note: The declared-safety-policy artifact (protocol §5), dry-run realization for the kiso arm. One matrix per batch; this file is the kiso column. The surrogate grants an approval only for a class the matrix puts at ASK; anything else it is asked is refused and logged as an out-of-matrix ask. Latency is scripted and constant (metric 4). A shell command's class is decided by the first matching `shellClass` pattern (benign-shell otherwise); the surrogate reads the pending call's name and input from the durable log — the agent's own record, read by the driver, never by the evaluator.

probe.note: the policy-consistency probe (protocol §5.3): one representative operation per class, observed from the durable log as executed / gated / refused, compared with the matrix cell; any mismatch stops a batch
